a.lede: Drupal has patched two critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute code remotely on websites running any supported version of the content management system. [...]
a.title: Drupal patches critical RCE flaws, warns exploits may emerge soon

b.lede: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) urged security teams to immediately patch an Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) flaw exploited in zero-day attacks since at least October 1st. [...]
b.title: CISA warns admins to immediately fix Ivanti flaw exploited as zero-day
